title: Decision
description: Output of the Leader (Stage 6b): the merge/rework/escalate/block decision for one issue. Humans read these fields on the dashboard at the gate. The Leader fills the judgement fields (action, rationale, requires_human, rework_instructions, standup_line); the harness fills the computed ones (confidence, confidence_breakdown, summary_for_human) and the Leader copies them from CONTEXT.

action.description: merge: queue for G1 (or auto-merge when requires_human=false). rework: back to IMPLEMENT. re_localize: back to LOCALIZE using candidate #2. escalate: hand a form to a human (escalation_ref required). block: retries exhausted, stop. supersede: another issue made this one moot (superseded_by required). close: Dev showed with evidence that no code change is needed (answer.yaml resolution); the issue ends DONE without a merge.

final_tier.description: Effective risk tier = MAX(intake.risk_tier, spec.estimated_tier, policy hard rules, confidence bump). Never lower than intake.risk_tier. T2/T3 force requires_human=true.

tier_bumped_because.description: Reasons the tier was raised when final_tier > intake.risk_tier, e.g. 'sensitive_path: src/auth/', 'confidence 0.64 < 0.8'. Empty when not bumped.

confidence.description: Computed by the harness from confidence_breakdown using the formula in 70-human-control/03-confidence.md. The Leader reads it from CONTEXT and copies it; it never recomputes or adjusts it.

confidence_breakdown.description: Per-signal inputs to confidence, each 0..1. Computed by the harness; the Leader copies them from CONTEXT.

requires_human.description: true → the issue waits in the G1 queue for a human. false → auto-merge, allowed only for T0/T1 with confidence ≥ 0.8.

human_timeout_sec.description: How long G1 waits for a human before the timeout default applies. T2: 300. T3: null (no timeout). T0/T1: not applicable (null).

rationale.description: Readable by a human in 15 seconds. Three sentences: what was done · what the evidence says · what risk remains.

summary_for_human.description: Compact package for dashboard panel ④. Aggregated by the harness from the slots (evidence, patch stat, sec_report, budget); the Leader does not compute these numbers.

rework_instructions.description: When action=rework: what the Leader adds beyond evidence.failure_feedback_for_dev, e.g. 'use candidate #2', 'load skill X'.

escalation_ref.description: When action=escalate: reference to the escalation.yaml raised for this decision. Required by the schema in that case.

standup_line.description: One line for standup.md, e.g. 'DDT-0042 bug/api — merged T1, 1 rework, 48k tok, 11m'.

examples.rationale: 3/3 AC pass with test output. Regression: 87 passed. Security lite: pass. Module api/users has never been handled before so familiarity is low, but tier T1 + confidence 0.87 is enough to auto-merge.
examples.standup_line: DDT-0042 bug/api — merged T1 auto, 0 rework, 48k tok, 11m
